faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV6 use?
faqLeft.a: The TDV6 uses a 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine, which was fitted across two generations of the Range Rover Sport: the L320 (2005–2013) and the L494 (2013–2022). The SDV6 is a higher-output variant of the same engine family.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Range Rover Sport TDV6 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,400 for both the TDV6 and SDV6. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover Sport?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the TDV6 or SDV6 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild TDV6 Range Rover Sport engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild SDV6 Range Rover Sport engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The SDV6 shares the same core architecture and wear patterns as the TDV6, and we service it to the same high standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover Sport engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover Sport if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Range Rover Sport engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover Sport owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
